## Coverage summary

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| Requirements | 44 |
| Use cases with content | 7 |
| User stories | 43 |
| Requirement ↔ use case links | 79 (3 confirmed, 76 proposed) |
| Requirements with no use case | 6 |
| Requirements with no user story | 9 |

### Requirements with no use case link

`DD05`, `DD06`, `DD07`, `AC04`, `VA04`, `VA06`

These cluster into two themes that no current use case covers: data discovery and
preparation (`DD05`, `DD06`, `DD07`, `AC04`) and expert-led validation
(`VA04`, `VA06`). Both are candidates for new use cases rather than for
forcing a link to an existing one.

### Requirements with no user story

`AD02`, `RE05`, `VO05`, `DD07`, `AC02`, `AC03`, `VA02`, `VA04`, `VA06`

::: callout-warning
## Status
All proposed links were derived from use case text rather than supplied by
stakeholders, and every row remains pending manual review. Nothing in this
matrix is sign-off ready.
:::
